method.approach: Source review and browser task walkthroughs using twenty independent Playwright browser profiles. Cases are regression evidence rather than participant feedback.

findings.problem: Account and analysis changes required finding Save far below the edited profile fields.
findings.change: Move saving controls before the form sections, keep them visible in the desktop scroll region, explain immediate versus explicit saves, announce saved status, and disable profile/analysis edits while saving.

findings.problem: Failed or cancelled synchronization left a stale finding-archives or page-progress message after its toast disappeared.
findings.change: Retain the actual success, cancellation or error result in the page status region.

findings.problem: Choosing an invalid replacement file retained a previous valid PGN draft, allowing import of the wrong game. File-read errors were unhandled.
findings.change: Clear the old draft when selecting a new file, show validation/read errors, disable controls while reading, and reset the file input so the same file can be retried.

findings.problem: Quiz choices conveyed correctness through color and locked after selection without an explicit retry.
findings.change: Name the correct and selected answers in text, announce correct/incorrect explanations, expose selected state and disabled choices, and add Retry question.

findings.problem: Course readers could only advance, the final lesson had no onward practice action, and missing-lesson recovery was English-only.
findings.change: Add previous-lesson navigation, a final Continue to practice action, localized navigation labels and a curriculum recovery message.

findings.problem: Contextual panels exposed an English Close panel accessible name in French.
The Masters platform control was announced as a provider, derived from an AI-provider label, and its inputs remained editable during a request.
findings.change: Name the control Chess platform and freeze platform, username and preset controls during import. Master study continues to leave the personal game library unchanged.

findings.problem: The tenth pattern was labeled 010 because its number was constructed by prefixing zero.
findings.change: Use two-digit padding so the tenth path reads 10.

findings.problem: Quiz content retained a rounded filled card treatment inconsistent with the editorial study surface.
findings.change: Use a ruled question section and square answer controls, preserving the existing palette and typography.

findings.problem: A completed import could be shown before its IndexedDB transaction completed, permitting an immediate navigation/reload to lose the imported game.
findings.change: Await durable storage before clearing or closing the PGN form, report failure and remove newly inserted rows on failure. A delayed transaction browser regression verifies the completion boundary.

additionalCoverage: Both online-platform account replacement, preserving manual PGNs and the other platform, failed-account safety and incremental deduplication.
Real Stockfish reviews including castling, en passant, underpromotion, sparse and damaged cache recovery, interrupted analysis and independent deep-engine download.
Sixteen desktop landing theme/locale layouts, mobile/zoom behavior, 108 consolidation route checks and 140 workspace checks.
One thousand rendered games, ten thousand storage records, legal replay of one hundred curated puzzle solutions and motif geometry.

designAssessment.identity: Preserved warm paper/graphite, olive, Georgia and ruled workspaces.

detector.assessment: Existing 11px technical-label utilities in edited components. DESIGN.md explicitly permits 10–11px technical labels; retained after source and rendered review.

limits: No sessions with real customers or assistive-technology users were conducted. Keyboard and semantic checks do not establish full screen-reader compatibility.
New Academy lesson prose and pattern guides remain English with an explicit French-language disclosure.
Engine ratings remain bounded-search heuristics, and practice effectiveness has not been independently measured.
Browser capacity and multi-tab concurrency limits are described in credibility-release.json.
